title: Understanding Bernoulli Sampling
text: Bernoulli sampling is a probabilistic method where each row in the table is included in the sample with a specified probability. This method is useful when you want a random sample of the data.

title: Why LIMIT might not be suitable
text: Using LIMIT in a SQL query retrieves a fixed number of rows from the top of the result set. This does not provide a random sample and can lead to biased results if the data is ordered.

title: Evaluating Emily's Suggestion
text: Consider the implications of using LIMIT instead of a sampling method. Would it provide a representative sample of the data?
